parameters.name: EffectStatuses
parameters.description: Filters the results by the effective status of the configuration.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for the query, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: NeedTotal
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the total number of configuration history records.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for the query, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
